patch.value: Evidence: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rust/actions/runs/37482885416/job/112335354628 . Coverage succeeds with 3059/3059 lines, 276/276 functions, 4626/4626 regions and 624/624 branches. Cargo audit succeeds; changelog-check then reports CHANGELOG.md out of date and exits 1. All 50 removed and 50 added diff lines are equal after line-ending normalization. The package .gitattributes has merge-driver rules but no explicit LF rule for CHANGELOG.md. Reproduce using the pinned pm-changelog/PM CLI pairing under a Windows checkout, inspect raw bytes and core.autocrlf, and verify a fix on all three platforms. No fourth CI round was run during the coverage task.
Windows changelog verification rejects text-identical generated output

After native coverage reached 100/100/100/100 at PR 60 head bfbbf89, Windows release-check fails at just changelog-check. Run 37482885416 emits a whole-file 50-line diff whose deleted and added lines are identical after line-ending normalization. Linux and macOS aggregates pass. Suspect Windows checkout CRLF versus generated LF; raw Windows bytes and checkout configuration still need verification. Preserve byte-level verification and establish deterministic checkout/generation before changing anything.
Windows changelog verification and all three release aggregates pass with deterministic line endings and unchanged coverage thresholds.

value.author: claude-orchestrator
value.text: Root cause: Windows runners check out with core.autocrlf=true, so the committed LF CHANGELOG.md arrives as CRLF and the byte comparison flags every line. Fix: .gitattributes '* text=auto eol=lf' (outside the managed merge-driver block); renormalize found no CRLF content in the index.
